name: cms138v6-preventive-care-and-screening-tobacco-use-screening-and-cessation-intervention
description: CMS138v15 Preventive Care and Screening: Tobacco Use: Screening and Cessation Intervention (2027 performance period). Screens patients 12 and older for tobacco use and recommends cessation counseling or pharmacotherapy for current tobacco users.

protocols.description: Screens patients 12 and older with qualifying visits for tobacco use during the measurement period and recommends cessation counseling or pharmacotherapy when the most recent screening identifies a tobacco user. Excludes patients in hospice.

meta.title: Preventive Care and Screening: Tobacco Use: Screening and Cessation Intervention
meta.description: Patients aged 12 years and older who have not been screened for tobacco use during the measurement period OR who have not received tobacco cessation intervention if identified as a tobacco user.
references: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force. (2021). Interventions for tobacco smoking cessation in adults, including pregnant persons: US Preventive Services Task Force recommendation statement. JAMA, 325(3), 265-279.
